descriptions.notStarted: Chumji from Korean Folk Town is looking to gather up some people to fight against tigers. Should I join?
descriptions.inProgress:
Chumji of Korean Folk Town is concerned about the fact that lately, the Hoguls have been surprising numerous people with their appearance at the Black Mountain. He asked if I could go up to the mountain, defeat 8 Hoguls, and bring back 8 Tiger Skins as proof.

descriptions.completed: Through Chumji's request, I went up to the Black Mountain and defeated 10 Hoguls, the same Hoguls that have put many residents of the Folk Town in fear. Also, as evidence, I collected 10 Tiger Skins, and gave them to Chumji. He commended my courage and for the job well done.
